room_rent.note: India Cover: actuals, any room category as per coverage summary. Proportionate deduction applies if room chosen exceeds eligible category; eligible room is Single Private A.C. Room (up to Deluxe Room) per proportionate deduction table.

icu.note: ICU charges covered at actuals within Sum Insured; ICU charges explicitly excluded from proportionate deduction.

copayment.note: 20% co-pay on assessed claim amount if insured (or eldest in floater) is aged 61+ at inception of first policy. Waiver of co-pay available as optional paid add-on (3.3.1). Dental cover has mandatory 20% co-pay regardless of age.

sub_limits.display: Few sub-limits: Gene Therapy capped; rehab, home care, medical equipment capped
sub_limits.note: Gene Therapy: 50% of SI (Global) or 50% India Base SI, lifetime 100% SI. Rehabilitation: USD 2,300 (Global) / INR 50,000 (India). Home Care: INR 25L, 15 days/yr. DME: INR 5L; SME: INR 2L. OPD: INR 50,000. Health check-up: INR 10,000 every 2 yrs. Second opinion: INR 5,000. Most core hospitalisation benefits are within SI at actuals.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible. Voluntary co-payment option available as discount add-on.

initial_waiting.note: India Cover: 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses. Global Cover: 90-day initial waiting period from first policy inception. Both waived for accidents and after 12 months continuous coverage.

ped_waiting.note: Base PED waiting period is 36 months. Reducible to 24 or 12 months via paid optional add-on (3.3.3 Change in Pre-Existing Waiting Period).

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for listed conditions including cataract, hernia, joint replacement, sinusitis, tonsillitis, varicose veins, GERD, calculus diseases, etc. Joint replacement/reconstruction has 36-month wait. Gene Therapy has 48-month wait.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% of India Base SI
cumulative_bonus.note: 25% of India Base SI added per claim-free year; reduced by 25% in a claim year. Max 100%. Applicable to India Cover only; not available on Unlimited SI option.

restoration.note: Unlimited Reinstatement of India Base SI after each claim settlement, usable for both related and unrelated illness/injury. Activated only after India Base SI + NCB + Inflation Protection exhausted. Not available on Unlimited SI option. India Cover only.

pre_hosp.note: India Cover: 90 days pre-hospitalisation. Global Cover: from date of arrival in city of treatment up to 15 days or start of pre-approved treatment, whichever is earlier.

post_hosp.note: India Cover: 180 days post-discharge. Global Cover: 30 days post-discharge.

day_care.note: Day Care Treatment covered under India Cover (3.2.1.2). Pre and Post-Operative Day Care also covered under Global Cover (3.1.2).

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary Hospitalisation covered within SI under India Cover (3.2.4), subject to 3-day minimum and exclusion of listed conditions (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation covered under India Cover benefit 3.2.1. Not applicable to Global Cover.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor expenses covered under India Cover (3.2.8) within SI. Donor's pre/post hospitalisation expenses excluded. Also covered under Global Cover (3.1.1) for transplant to insured.

ambulance.note: Domestic Road Ambulance and Air Ambulance covered within India Base SI (3.2.2, 3.2.3). Intercity ambulance (beyond 100km) has extended limit per schedule. Global Cover includes ambulance within Global SI.

modern_treatments.note: 9 modern treatments listed including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, immunotherapy, intra-vitreal injections, etc. Covered under India Cover (3.2.5) within SI.

consumables.note: Listed consumables (Annexure A-List I items) covered under India Cover hospitalisation (3.2.1). Non-payable items list also applies. Consumables included in Global Cover in-patient expenses.

global_cover.note: Global Cover is the primary/mandatory section covering planned in-patient treatment outside India for specified or all illnesses (depending on plan). Global SI: USD 1.5L–10L. Includes travel, accommodation, visa, companion expenses.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/quarterly/half-yearly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment premium.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document. Applicable on new policies only, not renewals or portability.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines. Apply at least 45 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, sleep apnea, external congenital anomaly, hormone replacement therapy, peritoneal dialysis, hazardous activities, NRI/OCI not eligible, treatment in India excluded from Global Cover
optional_riders: Waiver of co-pay (age 61+), Voluntary co-pay (10%/20% for discount), Reduced PED waiting (12 or 24 months), India Cover (optional add-on to Global)
